# Standard verbs

A noun that declares props and a store is a thing noun: it gets the standard verbs with no handler of its own. Every thing noun has each core verb; where the row's kind does not fit the store, or the store lacks what the row needs, the verb is listed but unavailable, with the reason. A verb that is not core exists on a noun only where the store has what it needs. A verb the noun declares by hand under a standard name replaces the generated one. A host mounting a tool's catalog gets the same verbs, forwarded.

| Verb | Core | Kinds | Needs | Subject | Many | Repeat | History | Undo | Confirm | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get` | yes | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get | yes |  |  | fetch |  |  | Read a thing's props: every prop as an object, one prop's value (prop), or some props (props) |
| `list` | yes | collection, instances | Store.List |  |  |  | fetch |  |  | List the things, each its props with id and label, as a page {items, page, per_page, total}; filter and where keep the things that meet conditions, sort orders them, group-by gathers them into groups, per-page and page cut the result into pages (rows, never groups) |
| `create` | yes | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), or a facts store with Create, Store.Create, a prop create writes |  |  |  | change | delete |  | Create a thing from props (an object), named props or prop=value words, each omitted prop its default; from copies a thing with the supplied props overriding it; a prop or alias owns its name, and a colliding control parameter gains create- prefixes until unambiguous; answers the new thing |
| `set` | yes | collection, singleton, instances | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Patch, a writable prop | yes | yes | yes | change | restore |  | Write a thing's props: props, an object of prop to value (a subset or all of them; @label, @owner and @archive name a prop by its role), or prop=value words; toggle flips one boolean prop; answers the thing after the write |
| `delete` | yes | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Delete | yes | yes |  | change | recreate | `Delete {{noun}} {{label}}?` | Delete a thing (asks first) |
| `archive` | yes | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Patch, a writable archive prop (role archive) | yes | yes | yes | change | restore |  | Archive a thing: set its archive prop |
| `edit` | yes | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get, Store.Patch, a writable prop, forms.edit (unless field is given) | yes | yes |  | action |  |  | Edit a thing's writable props in a form, or one of them (field, a prop or @role: with edit.field-only the form holds only it, else it is focused; a field that takes a choice opens its picker instead, edit.field-picker or the chooser argument); supplied props write directly without opening a form |
| `reveal` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get, a prop of Type path | yes |  |  | action |  |  | Show the thing's path in the file manager (a free verb of every noun with a path prop; setting paths.free-verbs) |
| `yank-path` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get, a prop of Type path or url | yes |  |  | change |  |  | Yank the thing's path or link into the active register (a free verb of every noun with a path or url prop) |
| `open` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get, a prop of Type path or url | yes |  |  | action |  |  | Open the thing's path or link through the opener table (open.openers; the OS by default); a free verb of every noun with a path or url prop |
| `open-with` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get, a prop of Type path | yes |  |  | action |  |  | Open the thing's path with a named application (a free verb of every noun with a path prop) |
| `follow` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get, a reference prop (Noun) | yes |  |  | action |  |  | Go to the thing a reference prop names: its noun's index, its row selected (a free verb of every noun with a reference prop) |
| `relate` (`associate`) |  | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), a relation store (Runtime.SetRelationStore) | yes |  |  | change |  |  | Relate this thing to another (to) or another to this thing (from), as noun:key, in any kind (default relation) with text and data; relating again updates the relation; a declared kind's rules apply. Every noun has it, both ends share one handler |
| `unrelate` |  | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), a relation store (Runtime.SetRelationStore) | yes |  |  | change |  |  | Unrelate this thing from another (to) or another from this thing (from): under delete.archive the relation is archived first and unrelating an archived one removes it, otherwise it is removed; the things are never deleted |
| `show` |  | collection, singleton | Store.Get | yes |  |  | action |  |  | Show a thing: its props (the CLI prints them); at the UI its noun's index opens with the thing selected and the focus in its form |
| `restore` |  | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Patch, a writable archive prop (role archive) | yes | yes | yes | change | restore |  | Restore an archived thing: set its archive prop false (archive's inverse) |
| `duplicate` (`dup`) |  | collection | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), or a facts store with Create, Store.Get, Store.Create, a prop create writes | yes |  |  | change | delete |  | Duplicate a thing: a new thing with its props (those given replace the copied values), never archived; answers the copy |
| `yank` |  | collection, singleton | Store.Get | yes |  |  | change |  |  | Yank the thing into the active register: its label (default), key, noun:key reference or record JSON (as) |
| `history` |  | collection, singleton | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), Store.Get | yes |  |  | fetch |  |  | The thing's history: the entries that changed or named it, newest first (rows of history-entry, each undoable by its actor) |
| `annotate` |  | collection, singleton | a store that is not a system fact (Store.Facts), a noun with an about prop (RoleAbout) whose store creates | yes |  |  | action |  |  | Annotate a thing: create a thing about it (text its label) of a noun with an about prop (by, default the first) |
| `token` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.ChangeToken |  |  |  | fetch |  |  | The store's change token: text that moves whenever its things change, so a reader (a host's index of a mounted noun, a count) reads again only when it moved |
| `watch` |  | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Watch, else Store.List (a singleton: Store.Get); a remote store: Store.Watch | yes |  |  | fetch |  |  | Stream what happens to the things (one, or those where matches): a JSON line per thing added, modified or deleted, from since when given; the CLI streams until interrupted |
| `refresh` |  | collection | a copy store (CopyStore) | yes |  |  | fetch |  |  | Compare copies with their source: one thing (its key) or every one; a plain diff (- the copy, + the source) opens with a pick per prop, local or source, that writes through set. Differences never block: at most a mark on the row (copies.marks) |

The subject is the parameter named after the noun's key prop: given, it names the thing; left out, it is the thing the request acts for (the focus). Many runs once over a visual selection, as one undo step; a verb without both a subject and many is never run over a selection. Undo says how history-entry.undo reverts the change: delete the thing made, restore the props written, or recreate the thing removed. Repeat: `.` repeats the write when it writes only simple values (enum, boolean, number, duration).
